prompt: What was the founding name of the company that ran the coal mining camp in the city where baseball great Willie Mays was born?
answer: The company was the **Tennessee Coal, Iron and Railroad Company**, commonly known as the **Tennessee Coal & Iron Company (TCI)**. It later became part of **U.S. Steel**.
